header: THE PROBABLE PF AT SUPERANNUATION FORM. Its fields are the figures a DSP employee can read on the PF page of the legacy intranet (opening balance, monthly contributions and the interest on them, each for PF (Emp), PF (Comp) and V.P.F), on the yearly PF statement (the taxable balance) and on the payslip (the monthly PF and VPF). I keep what is typed in the browser's memory only (React state): nothing is stored, logged or sent. The sums are in the pure file beside it (pf.ts); this component only collects the inputs and shows the results.

doc: THE CHART OF THE PF: one column for today and one for the close of each financial year, each column stacked PF (Emp) / PF (Comp) / V.P.F, with its year under it, its total on top and a scale on the left. Every size is relative (percent, rem, flex): the columns share the width but never grow wider than 6 rem, so that a few years are not drawn as a few huge blocks.

behaviours: the form is in three parts: the PF page, the payslip, the retirement and assumptions
the PF page part has the paybill month and the three rows of the page, each for PF (Emp), PF (Comp) and V.P.F: (a) opening balance, (e) monthly contributions, (f) interest on them

the three rows of the page are cells of ONE grid (a column that fits the longest name, then three boxes that share the rest and are never wider than 14 rem), each name is kept on one line from the large-screen breakpoint up (below it the name has its own line above the three boxes), and the names carry no wrapped hint
the page's own (b) interest on the opening balance is worked out, not typed (the form has no box for it)
the payslip part has the monthly CPF, the monthly VPF, the VPF ceiling (locked at 30,000) and the pension part of the company's share (1,250)
the retirement date is typed day/month/year, with the rate (8.25), the yearly rise and the optional taxable balance (TAXBL CB) of the yearly statement
the tax limit (2,50,000), the TDS (10%) and the page's rate are in the settings, not in the way
nothing is shown as a result until the figures are in, and it says what is needed
the old age-and-percentage questions are gone (no age today, no retirement age, no employee percentage)
the empty form holds no personal figure: no PAN-shaped text, and every box for a balance is empty
the chart has a column for today and one for each of the five financial years, each with its year under it and its total on top in crore or lakh
each column is stacked PF (Emp) / PF (Comp) / V.P.F with a legend, and a scale on the left from ₹ 0 to the largest figure
no column is wider than 6 rem (a few years are not drawn as a few huge blocks), and every size is relative (rem, percent, flex)
every label under a column is on ONE line (no wrap), and today's carries its month in a parenthesis: Today (04/2026)
the tallest column is the last year, and a column's height is its share of the largest total
a 30-year career: thirty-one columns are drawn (today and thirty years), the bars keep a small gap and their hover figures
the labels are thinned: at most about ten years carry a year and a total, always today and the last year, and the first of them is 'Today (04/2026)'
no two shown labels are neighbours (the step is at least 2 for a long career), so none touches another
a short career has step 1 (7 columns), so nothing is thinned
a short career of six years keeps every year and every total
